# Census baselines for the emitted-RC certifier, checked against every run by
# scripts/ci-check-perf with FERN_CI_PERF_GATE_STRICT=1.
#
# FORMAT: metric  value  tolerance%. scripts/certify-census writes the rows:
# what the certifier leaves unproved, and what it does with three planted
# imbalances per function (refuted, weakened, missed).
# docs/RC-DESIGN.md section 1.6 defines each one.
#
# The counts come from a static analysis of a deterministic compile, so each
# row has a tolerance of 0. A move in either direction is a finding. A fall is
# a gain to bank, and a rise needs a reason in the commit that re-banks it.
# The subjects are the compiler's own sources, so a change to those sources
# moves the rows too, with no change to the certifier.
x86_64/fern_main.unproved	1046	0
wasm32/checker.unproved	137	0
x86_64/checker.refuted	5325	0
x86_64/checker.weakened	241	0
x86_64/checker.missed	223	0
